title: Mingongo ya komipesa Pembeni ya Mosakoli
intro: Na mboka moko ya mosika, momemi-nsango moko ya lokumu akutanaki na koboya makasi epai ya banguya oyo bazalaki koyangela na eleko wana. Nzokande mwa sɛrklɛ moko ya milimo oyo emipesaki etɛlɛmaki pembeni ya mosali oyo ya Allah, na mposa makasi ya koyanola na libiangi ya bonzambe. Kondima na bango oyo ekoki kotɛngatɛnga te ekokabola ekólo moko ya nguya mpe nsukansuka ekolonga nguya ya kozanga kondima.
clues: Tozalaki mwa etuluku moke ya komipesa, oyo tosangisamaki na bondimi mpe na mokano.
Totelemaki pembeni ya momemi-nsango moko ya lokumu oyo bakonzi ya nguya ya mboka na bango baboyaki.
Tango motindami oyo atunaki, ‘Nani bazali basungi na ngai na nzela ya Allah?’. toyanolaki kozanga kokakatana.
Tosengaki momemi-nsango oyo aluka elambo uta na lola mpo na komema bondimisi na mitema na biso.
Na kati ya bato ya eleko wana, basusu bandimaki na nzela ya nsango na biso mpe basusu baboyaki na motó makasi, kasi Allah alendisaki bandimi.
Tozali ba Hawwariyyun — bayekoli oyo bamipesaki na Isa, oyo basalaki balongi na nzela ya lisungi ya Allah.

outcome.answer: Bakómaki koyangela bato oyo baboyaki nsango yango

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
